M-CATALOG.NAME: Catalog
M-CATALOG.purpose: Build a validated product catalog and resolve products by id.

fn-createCatalog.PURPOSE: Catalog exports createCatalog with validated inputs and explicit errors.

fn-findProduct.PURPOSE: Catalog exports findProduct with validated inputs and explicit errors.

fn-describeProduct.PURPOSE: Catalog exports describeProduct with validated inputs and explicit errors.

type-CATALOG_INVALID.PURPOSE: Catalog validation error raised on invalid input.

contract.purpose: Build a validated product catalog and resolve products by id.

param.name: input
param.description: Catalog validates every input before use and reports errors explicitly.

param.name: result
param.description: Catalog returns deterministic results; failures throw instead of returning sentinel values.

error.description: Raised when Catalog receives invalid input.

M-CATALOG.notes: Catalog validation rejects duplicate ids, non-positive prices and negative stock. Unknown product lookups throw instead of returning undefined so callers cannot ignore them.
